description: Search UniProtKB and return curated protein records. Pass text_search for a plain-language query (the 80% case) or query for the full Lucene field syntax (gene:TP53 AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true) — exactly one is required. Reviewed (Swiss-Prot) entries are manually curated; unreviewed (TrEMBL) are computationally predicted and ~30x more numerous, so reviewed defaults to true to avoid drowning in predictions — set it false to search both tiers together (for TrEMBL only, put reviewed:false in query). The organism_id and reviewed filters apply to the whole query. Request facets (e.g. reviewed, model_organism) for server-side count breakdowns. Results page forward with an opaque cursor; UniProtKB has no offset paging. An inactive accession the query matches (merged, demerged, or deleted) comes back in inactive[] with the accessions that replace it, never as a result. This is the discovery entry point — chain results[].accession into uniprot_get_entry for full records, or uniprot_get_sequence for FASTA.

cursor.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a prior response. Walk pages with this; random access to page N is not supported.

facets.description: Comma-separated upstream facet names for count breakdowns, e.g. "reviewed,model_organism,proteins_with". Returns a facets array alongside the hits.

fields.description: Comma-separated UniProtKB field names to project, e.g. "accession,gene_names,cc_function". Omit for a sensible default set covering name, gene, organism, length, reviewed, score, and a function snippet.

organism_id.description: Restrict to an NCBI taxon ID, e.g. 9606 for human. A convenience filter ANDed onto the whole query; resolve names with uniprot_get_taxonomy.

query.description: UniProtKB Lucene query with field prefixes — gene, organism_id, keyword (KW-xxxx), go (GO id), reviewed, protein_name, family, length, existence, accession. Example: "gene:BRCA1 AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true". Provide this OR text_search, not both.

reviewed.description: Restrict to reviewed Swiss-Prot entries. Defaults to true (curated only). false applies no tier filter, returning reviewed and unreviewed TrEMBL entries together; for TrEMBL only, put reviewed:false in query. Ignored when query or text_search already contains a reviewed: clause.

size.description: Number of hits per page (max 500). Omit for the server default.

text_search.description: Plain-language search across protein names, gene names, and function, e.g. "kinase apoptosis". Provide this OR query, not both.

name: uniprot_search_proteins

cursor.description: Forward cursor for the next page. Absent on the last page.

effectiveQuery.description: The query as the server assembled and sent it to UniProtKB.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_query`: Neither text_search nor query was provided. `conflicting_query`: Both text_search and query were provided. `invalid_query`: The query or text_search has unbalanced parentheses (rejected before any request), or UniProtKB rejected the query, text_search, fields, or facets value — the message names the rejected value. `invalid_cursor`: UniProt could not continue from the cursor (it answered HTTP 500) — the cursor is malformed or truncated. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Upstream facet count breakdowns. Present only when facets were requested.

count.description: Number of matches in this bucket.

inactive.description: Matching accessions that are inactive in UniProtKB (merged, demerged, or deleted) — not proteins to read, but pointers to the accessions that replace them. Present only when the page held any.

items.description: An inactive accession the query matched, with where to go instead.

accession.description: The inactive UniProtKB accession the query matched.

deletedReason.description: Why UniProt deleted the entry, when it says. Present on DELETED only.

reason.description: UniProt inactiveReasonType: MERGED, DEMERGED, or DELETED. Omitted when UniProt names none.

replacedBy.description: Accessions that replace it — the merge target (MERGED) or the demerge products (DEMERGED). Look these up instead.

uniParcId.description: UniParc ID that still holds the sequence, when UniProt gives one.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched — echoes the query and suggests how to broaden.

results.description: Matching active protein hits for this page. Inactive accessions are in inactive.

accession.description: UniProtKB primary accession, e.g. "P04637". The lookup key for uniprot_get_entry and uniprot_get_sequence.

annotationScore.description: Annotation confidence on a 1–5 scale; higher means more curation evidence.

entryName.description: UniProtKB mnemonic ID, e.g. "P53_HUMAN". Not an input key — use accession.

functionSnippet.description: First sentence(s) of the FUNCTION annotation, evidence references stripped. Omitted when no function is annotated.

geneNames.description: Gene names and synonyms for the protein.

commonName.description: Organism common name, e.g. "Human". Omitted when none.

proteinExistence.description: Evidence level for the protein's existence, e.g. "1: Evidence at protein level".

proteinName.description: Recommended full protein name. Omitted when the entry has none.

reviewed.description: True for reviewed Swiss-Prot (manually curated), false for unreviewed TrEMBL (computationally predicted).

totalResults.description: Total matches for the query before pagination (from the upstream result count), inactive accessions included.

title: uniprot-mcp-server: search proteins
